MOUREU_Charles.binding: Printed p283 says Academy of medicine1907 and four years later full Academy of Sciences (implied1911). Printed p344 actually says Academy of sciences1907; it is not OCR. Same Charles Moureu subject throughout, not Henri.

FAGE_Louis.binding: Fage notice1971 p676 actually prints Academy called him in1947.
